facts.fact: Teraco's JB2 Bredell technical specification (published 2020-11-04, no opening date given) describes an operating carrier- and cloud-neutral colocation data centre in Bredell, Johannesburg, one of seven Teraco regional data centres, with cabinet, cage and suite colocation.

note: Describes designs as concurrently maintainable but states no Tier III/IV or TIA-942 rating; cloud on-ramp is not a region.
